briefdescription.para: ModularRAGPipeline — explicit five-stage RAG orchestration with provenance propagation and per-stage telemetry.

sect2.title: Motivation (P2.1)
sect2.para: The existing TensorRAGPipeline couples FLARE/TARG gating directly into a single orchestration class. For complex multi-hop queries, cross-domain retrieval, and multi-tenant deployments the pipeline needs to be decomposed into clearly separated, independently observable stages:

listitem.para: Retrieve — ANN / BM25 / graph-walk candidate fetch
Validate — graph truth check + provenance tagging
Assemble — prompt builder with token-budget enforcement
Generate — LLM inference with policy enforcement

sect2.para: Each stage receives a ModularRAGContext that accumulates provenance, trace IDs, and per-stage timing. No stage may silently swallow errors; the pipeline is fail-closed by default.

sect2.title: Provenance contract
sect2.para: Every stage MUST annotate the context with its source identifier (stage_provenance). The final generate() stage captures the provenance chain in ModularRAGResult::provenance_chain, enabling post-hoc auditing of which documents contributed to which answer tokens.

sect2.title: Thread safety
sect2.para: ModularRAGPipeline objects are NOT thread-safe. Create one instance per request (or per coroutine/async task) and discard after use.
